Definition: to be vain in act, word, or expectation; specifically to lead astray
BiblicalUsage: 1) to act emptily, become vain, be vain; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to become vain; 1a2) to be utterly vain (with cognate acc); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to become vain; 1b2) to fill with vain hopes
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
